scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace fogo-api run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.lint: npm --workspace fogo-web run lint && npm --workspace fogo-api run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace fogo-web run test && npm --workspace fogo-api run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace fogo-api run test:e2e
scripts.db:migration:generate: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace fogo-api run migration:generate --
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace fogo-api run migration:run
scripts.db:migrations:show: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace fogo-api run migration:show
